items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the 2025 income tax assessment
items.quote: Der Einspruch muss binnen eines Monats nach der Bekanntgabe beim Finanzamt Beispielgüstrow eingehen, schriftlich, über das Portal ELSTER oder mündlich zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 18.11.2026, sent by post by a tax authority. Under §122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: 18.11.2026 + 4 days = Sun 22.11.2026. Since that falls on a Sunday, per §108 Abs. 3 AO it shifts to the next business day, Mon 23.11.2026, which is the deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe) date. The one-month Einspruch period of §355 Abs. 1 AO starts the following day (§187 Abs. 1 BGB, §108 Abs. 1 AO) and ends one month later on the same numbered day (§188 Abs. 2 BGB): 23.11.2026 + 1 month = Wed 23.12.2026. That day is a business day in MV (no holiday), so it is not shifted further.

warnings: The IBAN DE14 5139 0000 0074 4022 18 for the refund is well-formed (Bank: BLZ 51390000), but ownership cannot be verified from the IBAN alone — confirm it matches the account you expect to receive the refund on.
No explicit date is given in the letter for the Finanzamt to actually pay out the 715,00 € Guthaben, so no deadline could be computed for it.
